connector.name: Genesys Memory
connector.registryDescription: Open-source causal memory for AI agents: persistent, explainable, MCP-native memory (13 tools).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package genesys-memory. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the astrix-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for embedding generation (optional — use GENESYS_EMBEDDER=local for no API key)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for LLM-based memory processing (optional)
